subject.title: feat(memory): add multi-slot memory role architecture

question: Should OpenClaw adopt five first-class memory role slots with per-agent overrides and memory-role hook gating as a supported long-term core/plugin API?
rationale: This is not a localized bug repair: it adds persisted configuration, changes plugin activation and runtime dispatch, and exposes a new hook-role contract that external plugins may depend on.

options.title: Sponsor the role-slot contract
options.body: Accept the five-role core contract, require an explicit tested legacy migration and exact-head real behavior proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow to recall composition
options.body: Reduce the proposal to the minimum supported recall/composition seam and defer compaction, capture, dreaming, and user-model contracts to a separate approved design.

options.title: Keep the single core slot
options.body: Retain the current core selection model and direct optional memory workflows to existing plugin/skill seams until a dedicated API RFC is accepted.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the role-slot contract
recommendation.body: Accept the five-role core contract, require an explicit tested legacy migration and exact-head real behavior proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They were explicitly requested on the PR for this architectural decision; no stronger file-history owner could be established from the available review context.
